key_findings: Rush has minimal prereqs and excellent NP pathway - strong contender
Regis has GREAT location but problematic prereqs (Philosophy + 6 Religious Studies credits)
Johns Hopkins is elite but will be penalized by your competitiveness formula
DePaul offers lower-cost Chicago option with flexible pacing
Marquette is fast (15 months) but keeps you in Milwaukee
UK is a STRONG VALUE option - 80th percentile, low COL, standard prereqs
Baylor has EXTENSIVE religion/gen-ed prereqs despite being in Texas
Vanderbilt in Nashville is excellent but $136K is steep
UCLA is very competitive (7:1) and needs extensive chem prereqs
Yale has MINIMAL prereqs (only A&P!) but 3-year program is long
Columbia is elite Ivy but $87K + NYC COL (180 index) is brutal
Drexel is CLOSE TO PITTSBURGH - 11 months, standard prereqs, weaker NP pathway
Samuel Merritt requires Pharmacology + Pathophysiology BEFORE entry - unusual
UW-Milwaukee is cheapest option ($25K in-state) but keeps you in Milwaukee
Edgewood has 100% NCLEX pass rate, $45K fixed, but BSN-only (no NP pathway)
Alverno has MESA, AZ campus option - escape to Southwest while staying in program
